all_gather: gather arbitrary picklable data from all distributed ranks into a single list on each rank
all_reduce_mean: compute the mean of a tensor across all distributed processes using all_reduce sum then divide
init_distributed_data_parallel_model: wrap a PyTorch model with DistributedDataParallel for multi-GPU or CPU distributed training
broadcast_object: broadcast a serializable Python object from one rank to all other ranks in the process group
all_gather_batch_with_grad: gather tensors from all ranks while keeping the computation graph connected for backward gradient propagation
